notes.title: ONLY UP: LIZARDS MUST FALL - NEW GAME
notes.content:
[h1]ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST NOW![/h1]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38872489/86f1f9fcfdd5ed6defc43747a47272f3a11d6fde.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to the world of Hyperborea ONLY UP: LIZARDS MUST FALL!

Russ is tired of being attacked and humiliated by lizards. For the glory of their ANCESTORS Russ went into another battle to once and for all be at the top of evolution, as well as to destroy the nasty lizards!

Gather a company of up to 8 people and punish these sneaky and treacherous lizards![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279160/Only_Up_LIZARDS_MUST_FALL/

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
[h1]We have released an update for the game![/h1]

[h2]List of changes:[/h2]

[list]
[h3][*] Furry animation has been fixed.
[*] Fixed UI in Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Polish.
[*] Added VHS camera filter in the lobby.[/h3]
[/list]

[h2]Achievements:[/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] Added two achievements
[/list][/h3]

[h2]In the near future we plan to release a map update and add some interesting mechanics.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894499/0eb764d9445d886bb5e649f4a9205dbf4ee8b61d.png[/img]

[h2]We are also working on creating a new level. Write in the comments what you would like to see at the new location.[/h2]

[b][h2]Have a nice game![/h2][/b]
